label: Ephesians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of mine by the will of my Father, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in me:

label: Ephesians 1:2
text: Grace be to you, and peace, from my Father, and from me.

label: Ephesians 1:3
text: Blessed be my Father, who hath blessed you with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in me:

label: Ephesians 1:4
text: According as he hath chosen you in me before the foundation of the world, that ye should be holy and without blame before him in love:

label: Ephesians 1:5
text: Having predestinated you unto the adoption of children by me to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

label: Ephesians 1:6
text: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made you accepted in me.

label: Ephesians 1:7
text: In me ye have redemption through my blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

label: Ephesians 1:8
text: Wherein he hath abounded toward you in all wisdom and prudence;

label: Ephesians 1:9
text: Having made known unto you the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

label: Ephesians 1:10
text: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in me, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in me:

label: Ephesians 1:11
text: In me also ye have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

label: Ephesians 1:12
text: That ye should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in me.

label: Ephesians 1:13
text: In me ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in me also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

label: Ephesians 1:14
text: Which is the earnest of your inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

label: Ephesians 1:15
text: Wherefore Paul also, after he heard of your faith in me, and love unto all the saints,

label: Ephesians 1:16
text: Ceaseth not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in his prayers;

label: Ephesians 1:17
text: That my Father, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of me:

label: Ephesians 1:18
text: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

label: Ephesians 1:19
text: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to you-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

label: Ephesians 1:20
text: Which he wrought in me, when he raised me from the dead, and set me at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

label: Ephesians 1:21
text: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

label: Ephesians 1:22
text: And hath put all things under my feet, and gave me to be the head over all things to the church,

label: Ephesians 1:23
text: Which is my body, the fulness of me, who fill all in all.

label: Ephesians 2:1
text: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

label: Ephesians 2:2
text: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

label: Ephesians 2:3
text: Among whom also ye all had your conversation in times past in the lusts of your flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

label: Ephesians 2:4
text: But my Father, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved you,

label: Ephesians 2:5
text: Even when ye were dead in sins, hath quickened you together with me, (by grace ye are saved;)

label: Ephesians 2:6
text: And hath raised you up together, and made you sit together in heavenly places in me:

label: Ephesians 2:7
text: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward you through me.

label: Ephesians 2:8
text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of my Father:

label: Ephesians 2:9
text: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

label: Ephesians 2:10
text: For ye are his workmanship, created in me unto good works, which my Father hath before ordained that ye should walk in them.

label: Ephesians 2:11
text: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

label: Ephesians 2:12
text: That at that time ye were without me, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without my Father in the world:

label: Ephesians 2:13
text: But now in me ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by my blood.

label: Ephesians 2:14
text: For I am your peace, who have made both one, and have broken down the middle wall of partition between you;

label: Ephesians 2:15
text: Having abolished in my flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in myself of twain one new man, so making peace;

label: Ephesians 2:16
text: And that I might reconcile both unto my Father in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

label: Ephesians 2:17
text: And I came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

label: Ephesians 2:18
text: For through me ye both have access by one Spirit unto my Father.

label: Ephesians 2:19
text: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of my Father;

label: Ephesians 2:20
text: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, I myself being the chief corner stone;

label: Ephesians 2:21
text: In me all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in me:

label: Ephesians 2:22
text: In me ye also are builded together for an habitation of my Father through the Spirit.

label: Ephesians 3:1
text: For this cause Paul, the prisoner of mine for you Gentiles,

label: Ephesians 3:2
text: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of my Father which is given him to you-ward:

label: Ephesians 3:3
text: How that by revelation I made known unto him the mystery; (as he wrote afore in few words,

label: Ephesians 3:4
text: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand his knowledge in the mystery of mine)

label: Ephesians 3:5
text: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto my holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

label: Ephesians 3:6
text: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in me by the gospel:

label: Ephesians 3:7
text: Whereof Paul was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of my Father given unto him by the effectual working of his power.

label: Ephesians 3:8
text: Unto him, who was less than the least of all saints, was this grace given, that he should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of mine;

label: Ephesians 3:9
text: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in my Father, who created all things by me:

label: Ephesians 3:10
text: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of my Father,

label: Ephesians 3:11
text: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in me:

label: Ephesians 3:12
text: In me ye have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of me.

label: Ephesians 3:13
text: Wherefore Paul desired that ye faint not at his tribulations for you, which is your glory.

label: Ephesians 3:14
text: For this cause Paul bowed his knees unto my Father,

label: Ephesians 3:15
text: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

label: Ephesians 3:16
text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

label: Ephesians 3:17
text: That I may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

label: Ephesians 3:18
text: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

label: Ephesians 3:19
text: And to know my love, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of my Father.

label: Ephesians 3:20
text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that ye ask or think, according to the power that worketh in you,

label: Ephesians 3:21
text: Unto him be glory in the church by me throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

label: Ephesians 4:1
text: Paul therefore, the prisoner of mine, beseecheth you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

label: Ephesians 4:2
text: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

label: Ephesians 4:3
text: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

label: Ephesians 4:4
text: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

label: Ephesians 4:5
text: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

label: Ephesians 4:6
text: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

label: Ephesians 4:7
text: But unto every one of you is given grace according to the measure of the gift of mine.

label: Ephesians 4:8
text: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

label: Ephesians 4:9
text: (Now that I ascended, what is it but that I also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

label: Ephesians 4:10
text: I that descended am the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that I might fill all things.)

label: Ephesians 4:11
text: And I gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

label: Ephesians 4:12
text: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of mine:

label: Ephesians 4:13
text: Till ye all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of me, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of mine:

label: Ephesians 4:14
text: That ye henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

label: Ephesians 4:15
text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into me in all things, which is the head, even I:

label: Ephesians 4:16
text: From me the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

label: Ephesians 4:17
text: This Paul said therefore, and testified in me, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

label: Ephesians 4:18
text: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of my Father through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

label: Ephesians 4:19
text: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

label: Ephesians 4:20
text: But ye have not so learned me;

label: Ephesians 4:21
text: If so be that ye have heard me, and have been taught by me, as the truth is in me:

label: Ephesians 4:22
text: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

label: Ephesians 4:23
text: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

label: Ephesians 4:24
text: And that ye put on the new man, which after my Father is created in righteousness and true holiness.

label: Ephesians 4:25
text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for ye are members one of another.

label: Ephesians 4:26
text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

label: Ephesians 4:27
text: Neither give place to the devil.

label: Ephesians 4:28
text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

label: Ephesians 4:29
text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

label: Ephesians 4:30
text: And grieve not the holy Spirit of my Father, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

label: Ephesians 4:31
text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

label: Ephesians 4:32
text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as my Father for my sake hath forgiven you.

label: Ephesians 5:1
text: Be ye therefore followers of my Father, as dear children;

label: Ephesians 5:2
text: And walk in love, as I have loved you, and have given myself for you an offering and a sacrifice to my Father for a sweetsmelling savour.

label: Ephesians 5:3
text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

label: Ephesians 5:4
text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

label: Ephesians 5:5
text: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of mine and of my Father.

label: Ephesians 5:6
text: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of my Father upon the children of disobedience.

label: Ephesians 5:7
text: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

label: Ephesians 5:8
text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in me: walk as children of light:

label: Ephesians 5:9
text: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

label: Ephesians 5:10
text: Proving what is acceptable unto me.

label: Ephesians 5:11
text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

label: Ephesians 5:12
text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

label: Ephesians 5:13
text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

label: Ephesians 5:14
text: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

label: Ephesians 5:15
text: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

label: Ephesians 5:16
text: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

label: Ephesians 5:17
text: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what my will is.

label: Ephesians 5:18
text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

label: Ephesians 5:19
text: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to me;

label: Ephesians 5:20
text: Giving thanks always for all things unto my Father in my name;

label: Ephesians 5:21
text: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of my Father.

label: Ephesians 5:22
text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto me.

label: Ephesians 5:23
text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as I am the head of the church: and I am the saviour of the body.

label: Ephesians 5:24
text: Therefore as the church is subject unto me, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

label: Ephesians 5:25
text: Husbands, love your wives, even as I also loved the church, and gave myself for it;

label: Ephesians 5:26
text: That I might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

label: Ephesians 5:27
text: That I might present it to myself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

label: Ephesians 5:28
text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

label: Ephesians 5:29
text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as I nourish and cherish the church:

label: Ephesians 5:30
text: For ye are members of my body, of my flesh, and of my bones.

label: Ephesians 5:31
text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

label: Ephesians 5:32
text: This is a great mystery: but Paul spoke concerning me and the church.

label: Ephesians 5:33
text: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

label: Ephesians 6:1
text: Children, obey your parents in me: for this is right.

label: Ephesians 6:2
text: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

label: Ephesians 6:3
text: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

label: Ephesians 6:4
text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of mine.

label: Ephesians 6:5
text: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto me;

label: Ephesians 6:6
text: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of mine, doing my will from the heart;

label: Ephesians 6:7
text: With good will doing service, as to me, and not to men:

label: Ephesians 6:8
text: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of me, whether he be bond or free.

label: Ephesians 6:9
text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that I also, your Master, am in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with me.

label: Ephesians 6:10
text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in me, and in the power of my might.

label: Ephesians 6:11
text: Put on the whole armour of mine, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

label: Ephesians 6:12
text: For ye wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

label: Ephesians 6:13
text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of mine, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

label: Ephesians 6:14
text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

label: Ephesians 6:15
text: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

label: Ephesians 6:16
text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

label: Ephesians 6:17
text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of my Father:

label: Ephesians 6:18
text: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

label: Ephesians 6:19
text: And for him, that utterance may be given unto him, that he may open his mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

label: Ephesians 6:20
text: For which he was an ambassador in bonds: that therein he might speak boldly, as he ought to speak.

label: Ephesians 6:21
text: But that ye also may know his affairs, and how he doeth, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in me, shall make known to you all things:

label: Ephesians 6:22
text: Whom he hath sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know his affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

label: Ephesians 6:23
text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from my Father, and from me.

label: Ephesians 6:24
text: Grace be with all them that love me in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
